source: Not a book section. The one-game-across-modules shape follows CodeHS's project modules in Introduction to Game Design and AP CSA's class units. Structure only: no CodeHS text, problems or code is copied.

lessons.title: Many enemies, in parallel arrays
lessons.objective: Students will be able to keep several facts about each enemy in parallel arrays and keep them in step on every push and every splice.

lessons.title: The hit loop
lessons.objective: Students will be able to test every shot against every enemy with a nested loop that runs backwards, splices safely and breaks after a hit.

lessons.title: Waves with a pause
lessons.objective: Students will be able to bring enemies in waves that start only on a clear field, after a countdown.

lessons.title: What parallel arrays cost
lessons.objective: Students will be able to find a drift bug in parallel arrays and say how many places change to give every enemy one more fact.
